studentDocument.text:
In synthetic biology, innovative tools continue to emerge rapidly.

CRISPR-associated Cas12a nucleases process their own crRNA and introduce staggered cuts with sticky overhanging ends.

Meanwhile, prime editing couples a catalytically impaired Cas9 nickase to an engineered reverse transcriptase programmed by a prime editing guide RNA.
